hotkeys.list.description: Lists the hotkeys you made on the Hotkeys page.
hotkeys.list.returns: A list of hotkeys. Each has id, name, gesture (the keys, like "Ctrl+Shift+F1"), enabled (true/false), action (the action it runs) and group.

hotkeys.press.description: Acts as if you pressed one of your Cuebot hotkeys. Its "Hotkey pressed" trigger and its action run. No real key is pressed.

parameters.hotkey: The hotkey's name as shown on the Hotkeys page, like "Scene: BRB", or its id.

hotkeys.press.returns: true when the hotkey was found and pressed, false when no hotkey has that name or id.
